$description: EntityTitle (platform/components/EntityTitle, issue 803): its component tokens. The icon uses Icon’s, the tag Tag’s or Badge’s, the placeholder Skeleton’s.

entity-title-gap.$description: EntityTitle: the gap after the icon.

entity-title-tag-gap.$description: EntityTitle: the gap between the title and the tag.

entity-title-icon-color.$description: EntityTitle: the icon before the text.

entity-title-title-font-size.$description: EntityTitle: the title (13px, the list row text).

entity-title-subtitle-color.$description: EntityTitle: the subtitle under the title.

entity-title-title-line-height.$description: EntityTitle: the title’s line (20px, a list row’s text line and a badge’s height), on the 4px grid.

entity-title-subtitle-line-height.$description: EntityTitle: the subtitle’s line (16px): with the title, 36px on the 4px grid.
